results.title: Google launches Nano Banana 2.1 with better editing and subject consistency - Neowin
results.content:
Image Credit: Google

Google today announced Nano Banana 2.1, an upgraded version of its AI image generation and editing model. The company highlighted that this new Nano Banana 2.1 model delivers improvements across the board, with particularly noticeable gains in visual design, mask-based editing, and subject consistency.

Earlier this year, Google launched Nano Banana 2, also known as Gemini 3.1 Flash Image. Nano Banana 2 delivered the image quality of Nano Banana Pro while retaining the speed of Google's Flash-class models. Nano Banana 2 also brought several Pro features to a cheaper model, including real-world knowledge, improved text rendering, and better character and object consistency.

Nano Banana 2.1 builds on those capabilities with three major areas of improvement: [...] Visual design: Nano Banana 2.1 can generate better-looking compositions and more polished visual assets.
 Mask-based editing: Users can more precisely select and modify specific portions of an existing image instead of regenerating the entire scene.
 Subject consistency: The model is better at preserving the appearance and identity of subjects while making edits or generating multiple related images.

The improved subject consistency should prove particularly useful for Gemini users, as it keeps the same person or object consistent across generations. Google Nano Banana 2.1 is now rolling out across the Gemini app, AI Mode in Google Search, Google AI Studio, Google Flow, Stitch, Google Ads, and the Gemini Enterprise Platform. [...] For developers, Nano Banana 2.1 is generally available under the model ID gemini-nano-banana-2.1 and supports text, image, audio, and video inputs, alongside the ability to create images at 1K, 2K, and 4K resolutions.

Currently, OpenAI's ChatGPT Images 2.5 remains the leading image generation and editing model in the world. Images 2.5 is better at retaining previous changes as users continue refining an image, rather than altering unchanged parts or degrading the original image over time. Trailing OpenAI's model is Microsoft AI's MAI-Image-2.6 model, which was released in August of this year.

## Readme

Nano Banana 2.1 is Google’s latest image generation model — the fast, high-efficiency counterpart to Nano Banana Pro. It builds on Nano Banana 2 with sharper output, better text rendering, and real-time grounding, while keeping the speed and low cost of the Flash family.

## What it can do

Generate images from text. Describe what you want and the model creates it — photorealistic scenes, illustrations, product mockups, infographics, whatever you need. [...] Supports a wide set of aspect ratios including `1:1`, `2:3`, `3:2`, `3:4`, `4:3`, `4:5`, `5:4`, `9:16`, `16:9`, `21:9`, and the ultra-wide and ultra-tall `4:1`, `1:4`, `8:1`, and `1:8`. Set `match_input_image` to automatically match the aspect ratio of your input image.

## Output format

Choose between `jpg` (default) and `png`.
